newsitem.title: HONG KONG: PT Dharmala Inti Utama to launch $100 mln FRN.
newsitem.headline: PT Dharmala Inti Utama to launch $100 mln FRN.

text.p: PT Dharmala Inti Utama has mandated Peregrine Fixed Income to arrange a US$100 million floating rate note issue, Peregrine said Friday.
The notes have a final maturity of three years but can be put on the second anniversary.
The issue will be priced at 99.00.
A coupon rate has not been finalised but it is expected to be set at between 250 and 300 basis points over the London Interbank Offered Rate.
Roadshows were held earlier this week in Singapore, Hong Kong and Seoul and today in Labuan.
Launch is expected late Friday or early next week.
